units.text: INT. COAL-TOWN CURLING RINK - NIGHT
A single sheet of ice under a tin roof, lit by hanging bulbs.
A scoreboard with hand-painted numbers reads 7-7.
The stands are empty but for a thermos and a folded flag.
Cold breath hangs in the air.
BERNADETTE "BERNIE" ZIELINSKI, fifties, coach, in a wool coat and a hat with a pom-pom gone gray, stands at the boards with a clipboard she hasn't looked at in an hour.
INGRID VAN DER MEER, thirties, skip, crouches on the hack, broom across her knees, eyes locked on the button at the far end.
Last stone. Last end. Don't make it complicated.
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: It's already complicated.
units.name: INGRID

units.text: She slides out and releases.
The granite hisses down the sheet.
Bernie walks along the boards beside it, and Ingrid follows, sweeping hard.
Hard, hard, hard! Give it everything!
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: Nobody's there, Bern.
units.name: INGRID

units.text: Somebody's always there.
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: The stone slows.
Ingrid stops sweeping, and she sees what Bernie sees: it will stop a hair short of the button, one stone from a guard.
Off, off, off.
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: Off?
units.name: INGRID

units.text: Let it die.
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: She lifts the broom.
The stone creeps, trembles, and settles an inch from the button, nudging the opponent's red stone to the back rings.
Silence.
Then both of them breathe out.
That's it.
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: That's it?
units.name: INGRID

units.text: Measure it.
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: Ingrid pulls the steel measure from her pocket.
She kneels over the rings, checks one stone, then the other, and holds still for a long moment.
Well?
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: Closer. By a thumbnail.
units.name: INGRID

units.text: Bernie covers her mouth with her gloved hand.
Ingrid sits back on the ice, laughing quietly, the broom across her lap, tears freezing at the edge of her eyes.
You see that? You see that?
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: She's taking the credit.
units.name: INGRID

units.text: She is.
units.name: BERNIE
